label: **DERIVED:** Comment hygiene is a Python 3 checker that takes one or more explicit file paths and opens those files directly. It does not discover a repository root. It handles TS, TSX, JS, MJS, CJS, Python, shell and JSONC files, while skipping dist, node_modules, .git, .vitest.js and unknown extensions. If every input is skipped, it exits 2, which means no file was checked rather than a clean pass. **DERIVED:** Dist staleness needs Python 3, Node and the fixed helper at .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/lib/dist-freshness.cjs. Its root resolver checks the current directory first, then derives the repository root from the checker script. The helper has a fixed registry of packages under .skilled and considers an individual package provisioned only when package.json and node_modules exist. Without those, it returns unprovisioned, so freshness cannot be assessed or rebuilt. **INFERRED:** A repository can keep the existing dist hook switches in .skilled/hooks/hook-flags.env when it uses this hub, or point HOOK_FLAGS_CONFIG at a repository-owned file. That setting does not configure comment-hygiene rules or ceiling-report policy. A shared repo-local quality policy therefore needs a configuration path that all intended checkers consume. A fixture repository without .skilled, exercised with explicit-file inputs, would confirm how much of the current standalone behavior already works outside the hub layout.
